capabilities: Preview notes as mind maps in a dedicated view
Pin a mind map view to one document or let it follow the last opened note
Insert inline mind maps via markmap code blocks
Copy a PNG screenshot of the mind map to the clipboard
Style and fold individual nodes using inline HTML comments
extras: Notes that light/dark syntax highlighting themes do not switch automatically, and that markmap's extraJs and extraCss settings are not supported. Provides a Markmap settings section the author admits can be confusing and requires trial and error.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin to view your notes as mindmaps using Markmap.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to preview a note's heading and list structure as an interactive mind map.

relations.evidence: view your notes as mindmaps using Markmap
This uses highlightjs for syntax highlighting, so you need to use highlightjs compatible colour schemes

summary: Renders notes as Markmap mind maps in a view, with pinning, screenshots, inline markmap code blocks, and per-node styling.
